run_fixed_pts_eval: run fixed_pts_eval to compute SDF and gradient metrics on fixed evaluation points for a given timestep
run_sub_eval: run sub_eval to compute L1 SDF error, binned losses, and chomp cost differences between predicted and ground truth SDF values
run_eval_grad: run eval_grad to compute numerical gradients of an SDF interpolation at given points using finite differences
run_get_cache_dataset: run get_cache_dataset to create a SceneCache dataset from a sequence directory with depth and RGB transforms
run_get_dirs_C: run get_dirs_C to compute camera ray direction tensors for replicaCAD or ScanNet dataset formats
